kind: real-device evaluation of Node JIT and PTY/terminal support

node.v8Options: the runtime reports '--jitless (Disable runtime allocation of executable memory.) type: bool default: --jitless', i.e. this Node build defaults to jitless
node.withoutNodeOptions: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node -e ... still runs, but the default jitless flag remains
node.observation: re-enabling JIT needs a Node build whose default is not jitless (or a supported --no-jitless); the current packaged Node is compiled/configured jitless even though anonymous executable memory is available

pty.deviceNodes: /dev/ptmx and /dev/pts are absent in the guest rootfs
pty.observation: PTY/terminal remains unsupported at the device-node level; this is not fixable by a pure user-space loader and stays deferred
